quality_rules: Select exactly one matching fungi-processing variant before using composition requirements; never combine limits of dried, pickled, fermented, frozen, salted, oil-packed, sterilized or extract preparations.
For dried fungi, the freeze-dried and species (Shii-ta-ke) variants differ in maximum water content and organic impurities.
Source clause specifies processing-method, species (common and scientific) and mixed-species label declarations; see applicable updated labelling rules.
Maggot-damage conditions depend on severity and on processing style; defects and packing quality require direct review.

conditional_requirements.condition: Crushed fungi max 6%; carbonized fungi max 2%; damaged fungi max 20%; distinguish from maggot-damage limits
